# ofxAddonsJs

A html+css+js GUI for navigating the [danoli3/ofxAddons](https://github.com/danoli3/ofxAddons)' [db file](http://github.com/danoli3/ofxAddons/releases/latest/).  
An alternative to [danoli3's addons site](https://ofxaddons.danoli3.com) (which is PHP powered).

The resulting addons page is here : https://daandelange.github.io/ofxAddonsJs/  
It can also be used locally if you download the database.
